messages:
mike: Heads-up: planning an unpin of runtime v2.9 -> v3.0 tomorrow 01:00 UTC. v3.0 includes a new memory allocator and a patched kernel for quant-v3 that might affect SDK 2.8 clients. Need quick compatibility guardrails.

deploybot: auto: action=unpin, target=runtime:v3.0, plan=uf-8812, canary=5%, window=60m, fallback=runtime:v2.9.

anya: Noting SDK rollout: ~70% on 2.9, ~20% on 2.8 still active. If v3.0 has allocator changes we should avoid routing heavy-embed traffic to it initially. Suggest pinlist exception for "embed-large" for 48h.

chris: Agree. Also request to enable the legacy-decoder shim for 2h on v3.0 to guard against ordering diffs. We'll accept throughput regression.

nina (QE): I can run a smoke matrix (generation, embedding, longseq) on a staging fleet with v3.0 and SDK 2.8/2.9. ETA 30m. Will post failing prompts.

ops-bot: Telemetry hooks: watchlist added (decoder-order, mem-alloc-fail, p99). Abort conditions set: mem-alloc-fail > 1/min OR decoder-order > 4/min OR error-rate > 0.6% -> rollback. Pager on abort to #eng-oncall.

samir: Request: please exclude ap-east region from the first 20m canary — low capacity and a majority of 2.8 clients there.

mike: Command copied from preflight:
```
/deploybot unpin runtime=v3.0 --canary=5% --window=60m --fallback=runtime=v2.9 --plan=uf-8812
```

nina (QE): Started regressions. Early results: generation + embed mostly fine, longseq shows token duplication under heavy parallelism for two prompt ids: long_211, long_347. I recommend enabling legacy-decoder shim for 2h and keeping embed-large pinned.

anya: Applying pin exception: `/deploybot apply-pin-exception uf-8812 --target=embed-large --runtime=v2.9 --duration=48h`

deploybot: Pin exception queued for uf-8812: embed-large -> v2.9 (48h). Use `/deploybot approve-pin uf-8812` to finalize.

chris: Approving pin and shim. Also add rapid fallback: if decoder-order > 2/min for 5m, immediately route affected traffic to v2.9 and pause ramp.

mike: Runbook updated with those aborts and rollback steps: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/unpin-v3.0.

ops-bot: Routing update: exclude ap-east for first 20m; canary to avoid-quant-v3 hosts initially. Monitoring channel live.

nina (QE): Final: regressions pass with shim enabled; longseq duplicates suppressed. Will monitor during canary.

samir: 44d ap-east excluded, capacity noted.

mike: All set. Checklist: 1) QE ok (nina) 2) Pin exception applied (anya) 3) Shim enabled (chris) 4) Routing adjusted (ops-bot) 5) Runbook linked (mike). Launching per uf-8812 at 01:00 UTC. I will post telemetry snapshots.

deploybot: Plan uf-8812 scheduled. Canary start at 2026-11-10T01:00:00Z.

mike: Thanks team. Escalate immediately if abort triggers.
